programme.title: 耀眼的你啊
programme.desc: 殷桃劉以豪任重王媛可施詩主演該劇講述了都市女性職場奮鬥情感生活自我突破並找到自身價值的故事醫美銷售主任康子（殷桃飾）由事業成功，生活瀟灑自在，卻有教養女兒的壓力與不敢直面婚姻問題；林千語（施詩飾）看似有令人羨豔的婚姻，卻常年承受丈夫的言語暴力與他人對自己工作能力的質疑；心理醫生孟雨珊（王媛可飾）在事業上冷靜客觀，卻難解自己婚姻生活的難題與內心枷鎖三個性格迥異的女人在彼此的幫助下完成各自人生中的重要蛻變

programme.title: 文青這樣玩

programme.title: 熱鬧新聽力
programme.desc: 全新音樂派對準備上場！無論是新人還是舊將，一起用音樂圍威喂新歌舊歌快歌慢歌，想聽什麼類型的歌曲都可以一次給大家聽個夠！一個為澳門歌手打造嘅show-off音樂派對，絕對是表演我直到你另眼相看，將抑壓能量在台上釋放，各位樂迷一起來循環播放啦！

我們的河山
programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.title: 我要逆風去
programme.desc: 我要逆風去是一部都市情感與勵志職場劇，講述民族服飾品牌在電商經濟衝擊下復興的歷程自香港投行跳槽回內地投資公司發展的投資人徐斯（龔俊飾），結識了國牌服裝集團董事長獨生女江湖（鍾楚曦飾），二人因商業理念不同而互不對盤江湖父親的企業突然破產，江湖一夜之間由雲端跌落谷底而一直頗有事業野心的徐斯對江湖父親曾經一手打造的膠底鞋品牌騰嶽勢在必得，使得落魄的江湖決定不惜一切保住騰嶽經一番周旋較量，最終徐斯與江湖立下是否能夠復興騰嶽的存亡生死契

programme.title: 극장판-자막 게드전기-어스시의 전설
programme.desc: 1960년대에 미국인 여성 작가 어슐러 K. 르 귄Ursula K. Le Guin에 의해 쓰여진 판타지 소설 어스시의 마법사A Wizard Of Earthsea 시리즈 중에서 3권 머나먼 바닷가The Farthest Shore와 4권 테하누Tehanu를 영화화하는 작품. 무엇보다 미야자키 하야오의 장남 미야자키 고로전 지브리 미술관장가 연출을 맡아 화제를 모으고 있는 애니메이션.

programme.desc: 廚神菜園迎來麵糰節12位參賽者分成四隊，進行市集出菜挑戰每隊要製作一道鹹食和一道甜品，為數百名食客供餐和為慈善籌款各種大膽構思都要面對時間團隊合作產量和品質一致性的嚴峻考驗

programme.title: 小豆丁遊愛爾蘭英

Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Liz McIvor discovers how carving up the landscape in order to build canals helped further mans understanding of the earth below. William Smith, a surveyor on the Somerset Coal Canal, discovered a way of ordering layers of rocks and eventually created the first geological map of England and Wales. His ideas about the age and formation of the earth were developed long before Darwin published his theories of evolution

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson explores the history of Milton Abbas in Dorset, discovering one mans wealth and power led to a town being wiped from the map and replaced with Capability Browns picture-perfect village as part of the landowners showpiece estate

programme.title: Roman Britain: A Timewatch Guide
programme.desc: Alice Roberts explores how the publics view of Roman Britain has changed over the decades, examining events from the initial invasion, through to the construction of Hadrians Wall and the eventual collapse of the empire, drawing on the work of archaeologists and historians and using 50 years of BBC archive footage. With contributions from Charlotte Higgins, Adrian Goldsworthy, Neil Faulkner and Jo Quinn

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire
programme.desc: An uneducated teenager from the Mumbai slums is only one question away from winning a quiz show, but the authorities are reluctant to believe a youngster from such a humble background could succeed without cheating. Under questioning, he tells a police inspector the eventful story of his life - and how he came to know so much. Danny Boyles Oscar-winning drama, starring Dev Patel and Freida Pinto

programme.title: The Lost Libraries of Timbuktu
programme.desc: Aminatta Forna presents a documentary examining the literary tradition of Timbuktu in Mali, where hundreds of thousands of manuscripts have come to light in recent years. From the 13th to the 16th centuries, the city was a renowned seat of learning, and its black African scholars were revered throughout the Islamic world

programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Liz McIvor discovers how carving up the landscape in order to build canals helped further mans understanding of the earth below. William Smith, a surveyor on the Somerset Coal Canal, discovered a way of ordering layers of rocks and eventually created the first geological map of England and Wales. His ideas about the age and formation of the earth were developed long before Darwin published his theories of evolution

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village

programme.title: Roman Britain: A Timewatch Guide

With contributions from Charlotte Higgins, Adrian Goldsworthy, Neil Faulkner and Jo Quinn

programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. If only we had more Duggees muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, its a ride Duggees going to remember!

programme.title: Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jet Academy: Biogas Power
programme.desc: Glitch is excited when Lars refits the Grimbler with new, clean biogas boosters that could make it even faster than the Vroomster! The boosters run on gas made from food waste, and luckily there is plenty of leftover food in the academy canteen for the Grimbots to gather up. But Glitch overloads the boosters and BOOM! He loses control of the Grimbler and is sent flying across the academy, out of control. Lars leads the Go Jetters into action by giving chase across land and sea in the their all-a

programme.title: Asparagus
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its young Asparagus sharing his deep affection to wet weather in the song I Love The Rain.

programme.title: Garlic
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its fitness guru, Garlic, with a set of fun exercises to make you stronger.

programme.title: Young Veggies: Part 1
programme.desc: Evil Pea tells the story of how she and Supertato first arrived at the supermarket as young veggies, and how a young Supertato helped her freeze the veggie aisle! To be continued...

programme.title: Young Veggies: Part 2
programme.desc: Supertato reveals how he learned to control his potato powers, defeat Evil Pea and save the supermarket for the very first time.

programme.title: Fast Slow Fast Slow
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take it in turns to go up and down on the Dup Dup. Sometimes they go fast and sometimes they go slow - even The Noo-Noo has a turn!

programme.title: Bath
programme.desc: In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say bath and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different baths - a baby bath, a giant bath and a jelly bath! We see a bubble bath, a bird bath and a banana bath! Theres even someone dressed as a bath! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally succeeds in saying todays word!

programme.title: Supersonic Messy
programme.desc: Okidoodle is jealous of the new RoboCar, which can go super fast! Will Okidoodle be able to catch up with the RoboCar and earn back Messys admiration?

programme.title: Runaway Tour
programme.desc: Prestons automated scooter tour of Swoppiton doesnt go as planned. Mojo and Bo must find a way to chase down and scoop up those scooters, and get the tour back on track!

programme.title: Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum wont let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Caf in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but its a little different than hes used to... hes going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They dont understand what hes doing and think its funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - its King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that finding their talents means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Kinderdijk, Netherlands
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to Kinderdijk in The Netherlands to celebrate National Mill Day.

programme.title: Keepy Uppy
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum are enjoying playing Keepy-Uppy around the house, when Dad joins in and the game becomes the ultimate test of skill.

programme.title: Hairdressers
programme.desc: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says its not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Andy and the Velociraptor
programme.desc: When Andy loses his gizmo and gets lost in the dark, a friendly velociraptor comes to his aid.

programme.title: Tambourine
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play a fun game in Playtime Towers, but who can find the musical instrument that makes a shaky drum sound? Its a tambourine!

programme.title: The Cinema Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to attend the cinema together for the first time with Duggee, who teaches them that you should adhere to three rules in order for everyone to enjoy the experience: stay quiet, dont fidget or kick the chair in front and go to the toilet before the film starts. The Squirrels quickly learn that the short films they are enjoying are only trailers before the film starts. Hopefully, the Squirrels can maintain their focus in order to watch the film all the way through to the

programme.title: The Difficult Badge
programme.desc: Norrie admits that she cant ride her new bike because she finds it too difficult. So Duggee gives her some encouragement and lets her know that there are skills that he is still yet to master too, like skateboarding. In fact, each Squirrel has a skill they find difficult. Tag cant tie his shoe laces, Happy cant click his fingers, Roly cant swing and Betty discovers she cant blink. Now that she is not alone, Norrie agrees to keep trying as Duggee encourages the Squirrels not to quit when thi

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a noblemans reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughters lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar Drunken Cat who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous Twin Swords in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the schools honour.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces!

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: Inspector Lau plans the murder of his father-in-law and shifts the suspicion away. When his wife grows suspicious, she hires his close friend, private investigator Bong, to uncover the truth. As the plot unravels, Lau escalates his schemes to silence all threats, leading to a deadly showdown between former friends.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Destinys Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girls heart.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting Alfred Chang who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Huas hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob bosss collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the citys patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Things That Go Bump Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When something starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that its a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. Lola isnt very good at Hide Seek so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now shes going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesnt want the others to hear whats in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement cant happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song just for them, leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp its a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Dog the Right Thing
programme.desc: In preparation for the big race to determine the next Race Cadets, Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to build their own cars. The catch? The car parts are scattered throughout Pawston. The Not Yet Cadets compete in the final race to see which team will join the Race Cadets.

programme.title: All Paws on Deck Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paws anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawstons 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that shes not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Fancy Fifths
programme.desc: When Marty accidentally steals a pair of slippers from a department store, he plans an elaborate heist to return them and learns in the end that its easier to own up to your mistakes than to cover them up.

programme.title: Hedgehog Sitters Club
programme.desc: When a litter of hedgehogs are temporarily relocated to the habitat, Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria become their babysitters. The mischievous hedgies quickly wreak total havoc in the habitatand worse yet, Alex must sacrifice his plans to crash a photoshoot for the zoos pamphlet cover when the baby hedgies find the travel tunnels and sneak out for an urban adventure of their own! After an Adventures in Babysitting-style citywide hedgehog chase, our gangwith a newfound sense of responsibil

programme.title: Big Poppy Neighbor War
programme.desc: When a troll starts to ruin the fun of open mic night Poppy is forced to enter a compliment battle.Branch tries to drive Sky Toronto away when he moves next door.

programme.title: Remote Out of Control Critter Comfort
programme.desc: Biggie takes Branchs superpowered remote but must return it before Branch finds outWhen Poppy builds a new home for a group of cute critters she accidentally attracts their predators.

programme.title: The Knights Fall Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blades life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhminis hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years shes been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Fugitives Day Out
programme.desc: Boss Baby is framed for leaking info about the Stinkless Serum to PuppyCo and must flee on the run via Errand Day with the family

programme.title: El Apasionado Negocio de la Niera
programme.desc: Frederic makes a play to take over the towns babysitters by instituting senior sitting

programme.title: Plushythingy
programme.desc: When Frederic Estes creates the cutest plushy ever that is the hottest toy in town, the field team must destroy the last remaining one but are powerless against its cuteness

programme.title: The Fugitives
programme.desc: Now that theyre officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowheres many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way theyre going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: The Ocelot King vs. El Mariposa
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence theyve collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: Reign Of Fireworms
programme.desc: Fireworms invade Dragons Edge, while Ruffnut and Tuffnut discover that they have an unexpected connection to the island.

programme.title: Crushing It
programme.desc: As a Rumblehorn wreaks havoc on Dragons Edge, Hiccup seeks the help of Stoick who forms an unexpected bond with the rampaging beast.

programme.title: Quake, Rattle And Roll
programme.desc: Fishlegs and Meatlug liberate the Gronckles from a menacing dragon that has encroached on their ancestral home, Dark Deep.

programme.title: Journey to the East
programme.desc: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, theres a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village...

programme.title: Curse of the Monkey King
programme.desc: Po and the Kids take a shortcut to the boat bound for the Forbidden City, and are waylaid by a tricky monkey. Zhizhu informs Mayor Li of some distressing sounds coming from the Wellspring.

programme.title: A Game of Fists
programme.desc: When Po and eventually the kids finally make it on the Riverboat, they discover old friends, new enemies, and perplexing cargo.

programme.title: The Fugitives
programme.desc: Now that theyre officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowheres many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way theyre going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: The Ocelot King vs. El Mariposa
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence theyve collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: Goodbye Crood World
programme.desc: When Phil detects a meteor is hurtling towards the farm, the Bettermans and Croods must decide how to spend their last day on earth.

programme.title: Sticky Business
programme.desc: Struggling to find their purpose on the Betterman farm, the Croods see an opportunity to prove their worth by harvesting Phils perilous and sticky bounceberries.

programme.title: Guy Time
programme.desc: When Eep wants alone time with her new friend Dawn, Guy seeks a new friend of his own and finds an unlikely companion in Thunk.

programme.title: Qilin-mania
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yis building. In trying to protect Qilin from the mob of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the crew is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their distress grows upon discovering that this Qilin isnt an auspicious mythical creature at all but a nefarious robot sent by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Shack Attack
programme.desc: The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot Qilin and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season1. While captive, Yi and the crew learn of a higher power known as the Great Watchers, and that Mr. Lung is furious at Yi for unwittingly replacing him as the GW-approved keeper of magical creatures. Saddled with these mind-blowing revelations, the crew must find a way to escape and stop Mr. Lung from using creature magic for evil.

programme.title: Liam The Hero
programme.desc: In order to get a ticket to a Manga convention she desperately wants, Birch agrees to write a series of Manga strips featuring Liam as a suave, cool and heroic character. When Birch finally gets a chance to sit down and talk to her hero, he turns out to be a jerk.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: When Raffi joins Amelias rock band, Birch follows on his heels as the bands manager. Soon shes writing songs that pit her and Raffi against their podmates. Pod 4s true colors are revealed once Birch realizes shes gone too far.

programme.title: Love Lessons
programme.desc: Liams role as romance advisor to the boys of Cosmos High gets under Birchs skin. Offended that Liam thinks female behaviour is nothing more than a collection of symbols, Birch watches as Liam misinterprets Sandras signals and ends up with pie on his face.

programme.title: Miss President
programme.desc: Birch runs for school president because she wants to see changes to the Art program at Cosmos High. On a whim, Liam gets involved and soon his goofy antics are winning him favours. Before long, its an all-out game of one-upmanship between the two cousins

programme.title: Olivias Fashion Show
programme.desc: After attending a disappointing fashion show with Grandma, Olivia designs some fabulous clothes and is determined to put on her own show. Unfortunately, her models Ian, Francine and Julian prove to be more difficult to work with than shed anticipated. Its up to Olivia to think fast and make the fashion show work!

programme.title: Olivia Makes A Video
programme.desc: When Father takes an out-of-town business trip, Olivia doesnt want him to miss a thing. She decides to create a video diary, filming her family and classmates everyday life, which isnt quite as exciting as shed hoped. So Olivia adds her own touch to the final presentation: a big song and dance finish. Dad is thrilled.

programme.title: Olivia Leads A Parade
programme.desc: As Mother tries to get baby William to sleep, Olivia, Ian and Julian create a backyard parade. When Francine finds out, she decides shes going to make her OWN parade. Olivia eventually sees that two parades can be better than one and even figures out how to keep fussy William asleep.

programme.title: Olivia Tends To The Sick
programme.desc: Julian comes down with a case of itchyfootitis, so its Dr. Olivia to the rescue, with all kinds of silly treatments. When the condition begins to spread to others, Olivia imagines herself running an entire itchy foot clinic, and eventually discovers the perfect cure.

programme.title: The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Moms favorite dessert on Mothers Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!

programme.title: Rodney J. Dinkle, Babysitter Lights Out
programme.desc: When accident-prone Rodney gets hired to babysit a mischievous toddler, TZG secretly watches over their safety. When theres a power outage in Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly helps the townsfolk beat the blackout.

programme.title: Double Booked Gym Enemy Cricket
programme.desc: When both Sam and Gabriel pre-order the new Commander Kale comic but the supplier only sends one copy, TZG secretly ferries the comic book back and forth between readers. When Fawna teaches a silent yoga class, TZG secretly find and remove a loud chirping cricket from the Community Center.

programme.title: Merry Scary Christmas Time Waits For No Ghost
programme.desc: Merry Scary Christmas Its Christmas and Casper wants to spend the holiday with his human pal, Jimmy. Time Waits for No Ghost When Casper discovers a clock that can stop time, everyone wants to use it for his or her own purpose.

programme.title: Ghostbust A Move My Fair Harpy
programme.desc: Ghostbust a Move When Jimmys dad decides to move the family away from Deedstown, Casper and his friends vow to stop Mr. Bradley from selling their house. My Fair Harpy The Winter Chill Dance is coming up and Ra is determined to be king.

programme.title: Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabbys imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harpers first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harpers Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Edens fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harpers family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isnt good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what hes feeling.

programme.title: Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize hes missing home. Kelp feels like he cant choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Catch Me If You Sam Toy Driver
programme.desc: Its Tag and Scoochs first day of Race Cadets and Sam Whippet tells the Cadets that whoever can catch him in a race will be the new team captain. When Mom donates a box of Tags old toys to the new daycare center, Tag decides that the only way to get her box of toys back is to go around town collecting toys to swap out for her toys.

programme.title: Frank and Beans with Chili Little Hound on the Prairie
programme.desc: Beans is nervous that Frank is starting to make a new best friend, so Beans enlists Tag to help him win Frank back. Grandpaw and Grandmaw tell Tag the story of the early days of Pawston. Tags ancestor, Tagatha, built a steam-engine and turned Pawston from a one-house town into a thriving community.

programme.title: Sick Day
programme.desc: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

programme.title: Bad Egg
programme.desc: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

programme.title: CupKate
programme.desc: Its Kates birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melmans worried that his homemadehoof-made gift wont measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesnt matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Pest Side Story
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isnt until the gang winds up at the rats nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns its okay to say no.

programme.title: The Poppy Horror Picture Show Dinkles Dinkles Little Star
programme.desc: After hearing a scary story Poppy tries to help Biggie get over his fearsHoping to enhance Mr. Dinkles selfconfidence Biggie enters him into a Bergen pet show.

programme.title: The Party Games Trolly Tales
programme.desc: Everyone gets excited because its time for the Trolls Annual funbased Party GamesPoppy and Branch try to convince the Troll kids that the library is fun.

programme.title: Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayeshs wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Pings connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect Dudes Weekend camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Play It Again, Tim
programme.desc: When Tim is forced to take piano lessons, he actually enjoys them and Boss Baby realizes that Tim is being brainwashed by his piano teacher, slowly turning Tim into an old man

programme.title: Research Developments
programme.desc: Turtleneck wants to crack the Stinkless Serum formula and makes it a competition, pitting worker babies against worker babies, stating that the first one to the Serum will be the new CEO!

programme.title: Thats a Moray
programme.desc: When the team learns of several robberies in Mexico City that resemble the attack on the agency. Ms. Nowhere puts the pieces together and realizes who set them up: an ex-operative she used to work with named Moray. Now, she and the crew must infiltrate a masquerade ball to come face to face with Moray and figure out what hes up to.

programme.title: The Siege
programme.desc: Moray attacks the hauler with an EMP sending it into emergency lockdown and trapping the team inside. Now, its up to Roscoe, the only one small enough to fit through a vent, to find help. Meanwhile, Palindrome hunts down Moray using the evidence gathered by Ms. Nowhere.

programme.title: Into the Labyrinth
programme.desc: In order to stop Morays plan of directing a lava flow through Mexico City, the team must navigate through the underground tunnels and find his secret lair. But first they have to get their cars back from the DMV! Once they accomplish that, they learn that tunnels are much more complicated than they appear and Tony makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to help them stop Moray in time.

programme.title: Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 1
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders are surprised to discover who is behind recent attacks on nearby ships and to learn exactly what the ships are.

programme.title: Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 2
programme.desc: Heather joins the Dragon Riders, but its not an easy alliance, especially when Hiccup uncovers a shocking secret about her true identity.

programme.title: The Next Big Sting
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders rescue a wounded Speed Stinger and take it back to Dragons Edge, unaware of the dangers that follow.

programme.title: The Beast of the Wasteland
programme.desc: Po and the Kids are once more waylaid, this time by Mole Rats who have deemed Bao their god. But when Bao isnt able to defeat the mythical creature plaguing the Wasteland, Fan Tong steps up to save the day.

programme.title: Danger in the Forbidden City
programme.desc: Po and the Kids finally arrive in the Forbidden City. After an assassination scare, Xiao enlists Po and the 4Cs for help protecting her during her fathers funeral.

programme.title: The Battles of Gongmen Bay
programme.desc: Po and the Kids agree to escort a dirigible shipment of food to a drought-torn region of China. But Nu Hai has some suspicions about Shi Long, which she finds arent far off when she discovers the dirigible is set to explode...with them on board!

programme.title: Thats a Moray
programme.desc: When the team learns of several robberies in Mexico City that resemble the attack on the agency. Ms. Nowhere puts the pieces together and realizes who set them up: an ex-operative she used to work with named Moray. Now, she and the crew must infiltrate a masquerade ball to come face to face with Moray and figure out what hes up to.

programme.desc: 在宝和强的婚宴上，投影机原本正播着他们相恋过程，突然画面闪出强跟性感女子的做爱片段宝冷静地走到台上宣布离婚并将婚礼实时取消，这件事迅速成为网上热话一年来，回复单身的宝与风流快活强继续保持友好关系，一天烂滚爱玩的强竟带宝参加换妻派对，保守的宝本想离开，但遭强威迫利诱下无奈参与在换妻派对上，两人遇上杰与妻子曼丽，四人发展出浪漫而火辣的关系...这边厢，在另一个婚宴上当投影机又是播着新郎与新娘的温馨片段时，画面又闪出意想不到...

programme.title: 笑傲江湖Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: 一心退出江湖的华山派大弟子令狐冲意外卷入正邪纷争，邂逅魔教新教主东方不败，两人情愫暗生东方不败多次暗中相助，却在任我行挑拨与借刀杀人阴谋下，令狐冲误以为她血洗华山派同门情义与爱恨纠葛交织，一场生死难料的宿命对决就此展开

programme.title: 镖人: 风起大漠Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: 隋乱将至，逃犯镖客刀马受命护送神秘人，自西域大漠远赴长安不料护送对象竟是天字第一号逃犯，引发各方势力围追堵截，荒漠沙海间厮杀不断随着阴谋逐渐浮出水面，刀马被卷入一场牵动天下的朝廷与江湖博弈，在危机四伏的长安路上，展开一场生死难测的血战

programme.title: 成为饭吧A Good Supper

As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 爱的勘探法Exploration Method of Love

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.desc: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

programme.title: After the Wildfires
programme.desc: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Join the rescue team as they respond to a call about an opossum stuck in a fence that turns out not to be the kind of animal that plays dead. Inside the center, a goose with a serious foot injury receives physiotherapy before returning to the wild.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal Season 1
programme.desc: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spiders help, trek with the guardian of Earths last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if theyre to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.desc: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.

programme.desc: 轰动全港的凶杀案来到审讯最后一天就在陪审团准备退庭商议时，身为陪审员的著名催眠治疗师收到一段显示女儿被绑架的影片绑匪威胁他必须催眠陪审团，操控最终裁决夹在正义与亲情之间，他必须做出抉择，拯救女儿

programme.title: 有只僵尸暗恋你The Vampire who admires me
programme.desc: 新青春服装品牌的老板King少，带同怪鸡导演Roman，在模特儿经理人率领下，与一群美少女模特儿Macy，台湾小天后性感教主Chelsea，BiBi，Apple Susie等，来到阴气极强的东龙岛上，大拍性感泳衣造型照及开派对岛上四处埋有僵尸，众美女模特儿却不知危险，更为争夺岛上钻石王老五King少而大斗法，直到挂起八号风球，岛上交通断絶，此时僵尸出土狂咬居民，美少女陷入险境，在岛上孤立无援...

programme.title: 出走的决心Like A Rolling Stone
programme.desc: 中国式好妈妈李红半生任劳任怨，在日复一日的家务与丈夫的冷漠中感到窒息一场高中同学会意外点燃了她被埋没的青春梦想，她决定打破沉重的家庭枷锁，向妻子与母亲的身份辞职李红毅然驾车出走，独自踏上重启人生的漫漫旅程，在广阔天地间寻回那个遗失已久的自我

programme.title: 扎职 2The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: 黑帮成员阿齐发现伏击黑帮老大的竟是儿时好兄弟阿猫，但他仍协助阿猫逃离香港17年后，阿齐已是黑帮内举足轻重的分子一天，阿齐重遇阿猫，知道若黑帮兄弟发现阿猫的行踪，他定必死无疑阿齐在黑帮与兄弟情间，最后会如何选择？

programme.title: 团圆饭Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: 朝阳和子虹终于到了谈婚论嫁的阶段，但未造访彼此家长在一次客户的要求下，他们俩必须在年除夕当晚与家人共享团圆饭，以直播方式来推销客户的产品可是朝阳和妈妈关系不好，长年不相往来，于是突发奇想请了一群演员来扮家人出席饭局本该喜气洋洋的聚会，却变得啼笑皆非！

programme.title: 靠近我一点.I Believe
programme.desc: 等了初恋男友10年的林楚楚，最终等来的是男友和别人的婚礼正当她对感情失去信心的时候，一位婚礼策划师和一位高富帅男神同时出现在楚楚的生活中，陪她走出了这段黑暗时光面对同样真挚的两个人，楚楚的感情也来到了必须抉择的十字路口，她最后会如何抉择？

programme.title: 天堂旅行团Always Have Always Will
programme.desc: 失意的青年与乐观活泼的小女孩意外相遇，共同开启了一段疗愈心灵的未知旅程两人在人生的起落中患难与共，用彼此的陪伴缝合生命的伤口在这段笑泪交织的征途中，他们不仅寻获了生存的勇气，更在黑暗的人生尽头，为彼此点燃了希望的微光

programme.title: 失衡凶间Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: 电影由三个发生于城市森林暗黑角落的诡异短篇故事组成年轻歌手搬到新居后，感到有灵异生物在角落，导致抑郁症复发；一位网红来到商场表演，最后却变成一场死亡直播；唐楼租客连手对抗楼梯出现的神秘怪客

programme.title: 叶问：终极一战Ip Man- The Final Fight
programme.desc: 电影把这位一代宗师叶问晚年在香港的生活如实呈现包括叶问不顾徒弟的反对，在妻子死后与红颜知己歌女的一段缘，与长子叶准之间亦师亦父的父子情，及与晋身成国际武打巨星的徒弟李小龙的重遇等

programme.title: 我们一起发Lets Get Rich
programme.desc: 贾氏家族是一群聪明的台湾骗徒他们受聘于一名诈骗高手，策划一场复杂的诈骗行动，旨在揭露一位贪污的科技大亨所经营的庞氏骗局，并从中夺取数百万元赃款

programme.title: 过时.过节Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: 八年前，一个传统客家家庭在冬至饭局上的一场争吵，令一家人难以原谅彼此，从此未曾一起过节直至八年后，表妹忽然从英国回港，希望促成一场冬至饭局面临瓦解的危局，这饭局或许也是这个家庭修补关系的契机

programme.title: 生死危机Battle of the Wolf
programme.desc: 前特种部队军官张智勇与妻子在返国航班遇上国际恐怖分子的劫持事件危在旦夕之际，他凭着卓越的军事智慧与英勇无惧的精神，拯救妻子与全体乘客，成功摧毁敌人的恐怖计划，带领众人化险为夷

programme.title: 鹦鹉杀Tainted Love
programme.desc: 都市白领周冉在一次网恋中，被骗走了55万循着骗子留下的蛛丝马迹，周冉来到沿海小城，并意外结识了两名青年周冉渐渐发现二人身上隐藏着自己受骗的线索，一场复仇之计也由此展开.

programme.title: 寻秦记Back to the Past
programme.desc: 项少龙助嬴政一统天下后一家归隐二十年，不料，曾因时光机实验含冤入狱的科学家Ken执念成魔，率领配备现代军火的雇佣兵悍然穿越时空，密谋刺杀秦王面对企图改写历史的现代武装势力，久别廿载的师徒二人被迫再度连手，合力化解秦朝危机，捍卫历史与命运

programme.title: 成为饭吧A Good Supper
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着饭店招牌的破旧白米饭店女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季Breakfast In China S5

programme.title: 一城一味八闽有鲜味One City One Taste. Fujian
programme.desc: 一城一味八闽有鲜味，美食年番一城一味系列本季八闽有鲜味以福州为核心，以鲜味为指引，辐射周围的泉州漳州莆田宁德平潭等极具美食人文自然特色，且用户好奇度高的城市，寻觅最能代表当地特色的鲜味美食，突出食材鲜做法鲜味道鲜佐料鲜的八闽鲜味也通过一个个不同的美食与美食背后的故事，让观众感受到这些城市的温度与魅力

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 爱的勘探法Exploration Method of Love
programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Jingjing and Lu Ze break up over the company crisis. Qian Fei refuses to apologize for private matters, while Li Yifei quietly comforts her and their domestic intimacy deepens.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.desc: Alim, seorang pemuda Cina Peranakan yang disenangi penduduk kampung atas sikap ringan tulang, mengorbankan masa dan tenaga demi membina titi kayu bersama seorang budak bernama Umar, meskipun tidak mendapat sokongan ketua kampung.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Haziq datang melawat Aisyah di kondo untuk bertanya khabar hal kejadian semalam. Ketika itu, Aisyah sedang masak di dapur dan dengan sengaja Iskandar pergi mengganggu Aisyah untuk membuatkan Haziq sedar bahawa Aisyah adalah isterinya. Tengku Maria datang ke kondo kerana mengesyaki sesuatu yang tidak kena berkenaan Aisyah. Tengku Maria mahukan semua persoalan yang bermain di mindanya terjawab. Dia melihat Aisyah ada di kondo itu, dari situ hatinya semakin kuat mahu mengetahui kebenaran tentang Aisyah dari mulut Iskandar. Haziq membantu Iskandar menjelaskan perkara itu. Tengku Maria mengingatkan Iskandar bahawa hatinya yang telah terguris gara-gara Iskandar meninggikan suara. Tengku Maria meminta Iskandar mempercepatkan majlis pertunangan dengan Puteri Waiduri jika mahu Tengku Maria memaafkannya. Aisyah mendengar segala-galanya, dia cuba sedaya upaya untuk menyembunyikan perasaannya yang sebenar.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan meluahkan punca dia bersikap dingin dengan Antasya apabila mengetahui Antasya merupakan anak kepada pembunuh ayahnya. Antasya mempertahankan ayahnya kerana percaya ayahnya tidak bersalah. Syarfan menegejar teksi yang dinaiki oleh Antasya apabila mengetahui gadis itu berada di dalam bahaya. Teksi yang dinaiki oleh Antasya , Razali dan Hadi meletup. Syarfan merintih dan menyalahkan Datin Jasmin kerana menetang hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Di hari terakhir Qasih di Madinah beliau cuba mencari restoran makanan melayu namun tidak kedapatan dan terpaksa juga menjamu dengan makanan arab tetapi malangnya setelah selesai makan Qasih tidak jumpa jalan balik ke hotel dan terpaksa mengganggu Jazlan yang sedang kuliah. Di waktu malamnya Jazlan membawa Qasih untuk masuk ke Raudah sebelum berangkat balik ke Malaysia esoknya. Di dalam kapal terbang balik ke tanah air, Qasih bermimpi bersama Jazlan menulis namanya di batu Jabal Rahmah

programme.title: Ekspresi Fesyen
programme.desc: Ekspresi Fesyen minggu ini host Aqilah Azali akan berbual fesyen bersama Mawi dari kumpulan Masdo. Akan berkenalan dengan pereka kasut dari perfect duo juga kita akan disajikan dengan segala macam info yang menarik tentang Fesyen.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Tindakan Mat telah membuatkan keadaan menjadi lebih keruh. Khai muncul kembali dan ketiga-tiga mereka harus mencari cara untuk memusnahkan perkahwinan Mat dan Deanna sebelum ia menjadi realiti!

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah rasa kepenatan namun dia cuba menyesuaikan diri sebagai isteri dan ibu kepada Zahin. Urusan harian sebagai surirumah agak melelahkan. Namun dia bahagia apabila guru tadika Zahin memberitahu akan perubahan positif Zahin selepas Farah menggantikan tempat arwah Mamanya. Farah mula rasa terkilan dan dalam dilema apabila Liza dan Nazim sudah membuat permohonan untuk melanjutkan pengajian peringkat Master di Universiti Manchester. Joshua pula mula rapat dengan Myra dan mengambil berat akan kebajikan Myra. Dia berpakat dengan Myra untuk mengenakan Lukman setelah mengetahui siapa sebenarnya lelaki yang dibenci Myra itu. Lukman bengang apabila Farah tidak mengambil Zahin di tadika sedangkan Farah kepenatan menguruskan hal ehwal rumahtangga. Farah terkilan kerana Lukman menuduhnya pura-pura sakit dan banyak beralasan. Budi terkejut apabila Myra tiba-tiba muncul di pejabat.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah menghubungi Liza setelah dia jatuh pitam di rumahnya. Liza menghantar Farahke klinik. Dia mula mengesyaki ada sesuatu yang tidak kena dengan Farah kerana dia tidak pernah berkeadaan sedemikian. Mereka terkejut melihat Lukman beradadi rumah ketika Liza menghantarnya pulang.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih kembali ke tanah air selepas mengerjakan Umrah dan disambut oleh ibunya Khatijah dan di hari pertama perpisahan tersebut Qasih dan Jazlan bermimpi antara satu sama lain di dalam tidur mereka. Qasih pernah mengambil gambar Jazlan tidur semasa sedang menunggu beliau di lobi hotel dan oleh kerana sakit hati terhadap Jazlan, Qasih telah viralkan gambar tersebut sehingga membuatkan Bos Travel Ejen memarahi Jazlan kerana tidur semasa bertugas dan gambar tersebut juga viral di Malaysia. Keesokan malamnya, di dalam tidur, Jazlan bermimpikan Qasih sekali lagi dan membuatkan dia tidak keruan lalu menalipon ibunya Alawiyah untuk mendapatkan kepastian samada benar atau tidak yang beliau telah ditunangkan dengan Qasih

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya terselamat dan berada di bawah jagaan Hadi. Dia ingin pulang ke bandar. Hadi keberatan kerana mengetahui bahaya yang menanti. Hadi mulai jatuh cinta pada Antasya. Dia menawarkan diri menemani Antasya pulang. Syarfan dan Antasya bertemu semula disebuah taman secara tidak sengaja. Dia menceritakan semula apa yang berlaku kepada Syarfan. Hadi terkorban apabila cuba melindungi Antasya daripada dibunuh oleh orang Datin Jasmin.

programme.title: Love Reborn
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang komikus yang terikat dengan kisah silamnya, bertemu dengan sekumpulan anak band yang turut mencari makna hidup mereka. Perjalanan mereka merungkai masa lalu sambil berdepan konflik, persahabatan dan emosi yang mengubah hidup.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Impian memiliki TG Holdings merupakan satu impian terbesar buat diri Iskandar. Dia tidak mampu menghentikan rancangan dan permintaan Tengku Maria untuk melihat dia dan Puteri Waiduri bertunang, meskipun kemarahan Iskandar terhadap Puteri Waidur masih kuat dengan kisah silam mereka, namun Iskandar terpaksa akur. Luluh hati seorang isteri apabila terpaksa melihat sendiri suaminya bertunang dengan wanita lain. Aisyah menahan segala rasa pedih itu, dia sedar akan dirinya yang tidak layak untuk Iskandar. Aisyah sedih melihat majlis pertunangan Puteri Waiduri dan Iskandar berjalan dengan suasana yang meriah. Tidak mampu lagi untuk berlagak tenang, Aisyah pergi meninggalkan majlis. Iskandar tercari-cari kehilangan Aisyah di majlis itu, dia dengan beraninya meluahkan isi hatinya kepada Aisyah dan menjelaskan segala yang berlaku ini bukan kehendaknya. Demi membuktikan kata-katanya benar, Iskandar membawa Aisyah pergi berbulan madu.

programme.desc: Semasa keluar berkhemah, San dan rakan-rakannya dari sekolah menengah merakam gambar meteor yang terhempas. Gambar itu mengandungi petunjuk kematian seorang saintis yang menjalankan kerja eksperimen dengan organ manusia dan kemungkinan kaitan dengan ahli sihir Kemboja.

programme.title: Black S1 EP6
programme.desc: Di Seri Setia, Black dan Sofia bekerjasama untuk menghalang satu pembunuhan yang berpotensi untuk berlaku. Semasa berada di sana, Black terimbas kembali masa lalu Malik, satu fenomena yang membingungkannya. Pemergian mereka ini juga merupakan titik perubahan cara Sofia melihat keupayaannya. Kesanggupan Sofia menggadaikan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa orang lain memperbaharui tanggapan Black terhadapnya. Adakah cinta mula berputik? Black tertarik dan pada masa yang sama bingung dengan perasaannya terhadap Sofia, satu perasaan yang asing buat Black, seorang yang mementingkan diri. Tetapi hari yang bersinar menjadi pudar apabila Black kembali ke rumah dan mendapati bilik tersembunyi Malik telah digeledah dan dikosongkan. Sementara itu, pembunuh upahan telah meragut nyawa seorang lagi mangsa dan Detektif Borhan mendapati kematian itu ada kaitan dengan pembunuhan Nurul Najwa.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Jack, seorang profesor arkeologi yang terkenal di dunia, dan pasukannya sedang dalam pencarian besar-besaran untuk mencari harta karun purba India yang hilang apabila mereka diserang hendap oleh sekumpulan tentera upahan dan dibiarkan mati.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP19
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 12 tahun lalu, Tok Hashim sangat marah apabila mengetahui bahawa Wan Peah akan berkahwin. Oleh sebab itu Tok Hashim bersama isterinya Mak Timah membuat fitnah dan menghalau Wan Peah dari kampung. Suatu hari, Mak Timah bersama Cikgu Zaiton menghalau Ramli dan isterinya kerana dikatakan cuba membuat huru-hara di kampung. Tiba-tiba muncul Wan Peah di jendela, ini membuat Mak Timah melarikan diri. Yeh, Li, dan Ghani pergi ke rumah Ramli untuk menziarahi bayi sulungnya. Sekali lagi muncul Wan Peah dari dalam rumah.

programme.title: Black S2 EP1

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP6
programme.desc: Tentera Mel terbukti kritikal apabila McCall diupah oleh D.A. untuk mencari penembak tepat. Delilah mengalami PTSD akibat kejadian tembakan itu.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan

Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. programme.title: Boneka
programme.desc: Demi mengejar kehidupan sempurna, pengkhianatan seorang wanita terhadap suami yang pernah menyelamatkannya bermula apabila dia hanyut dalam godaan cinta dan kemewahan lelaki lain.
